definitions.explanation: A small, concealable weapon designed to be thrown, historically associated with ninja. Comes in various shapes including star-shaped ({多角形|たかくけい}) and straight needle-like forms ({棒手裏剣|ぼうしゅりけん}). Widely known internationally through ninja-themed media.

examples.japanese: {手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
⟦{忍者|にんじゃ}→忍者：11112_ninja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{忍者|にんじゃ}→忍者：11112_ninja⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦{投|な}げ→投げ：21942_nage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried throwing shuriken at a ninja experience attraction.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard collocation is {手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw a shuriken). The word literally means "blade hidden in the hand" ({手|しゅ} = hand, {裏|り} = back/hidden, ⟦{剣|けん}→剣：11819_ken⟧ = blade).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw a shuriken
- {手裏剣|しゅりけん}⟦{投|な}げ→投げ：21942_nage⟧: shuriken throwing (as an activity)
- ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧{手裏剣|しゅりけん}: straight shuriken (needle type)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Shuriken-throwing activities are popular at ninja-themed tourist attractions in Japan, particularly in {伊賀|いが} (Mie Prefecture) and {甲賀|こうか} (Shiga Prefecture), two regions historically associated with ninja.
